authorisation: User decisions 2026-11-12: NPIPE/PR4 excluded; re-fit approved on remaining channels; then 'record input hashes' and 'add nuisance + free psi' approved. Unblinded run on those channels; NOT the CORE-07 production inference.
changes_enabling: count-dipole responses replaced by R = 2 + x(1+alpha): slopes declared from source-measured proxies (NVSS 1.043, RACS 0.948, Quaia 1.9 = midpoint of 1.6-2.2; G<20.5 slope unmeasured, same value); alpha declared nuisance in [0.5,1.0], default 0.75 (not identifiable: L2 nullity 1). The old untraced 3.50/3.30/3.50 are gone. The Gaia glide response 0.92 is still untraced.
findings: Count dipoles imply |beta_MO| = 3.7e-3 (alpha 1.0) to 4.4e-3 (alpha 0.5), i.e. 3.0-3.6x the CMB-dipole speed (previous untraced constants gave 5.8e-3, 4.7x). An excess over the CMB-dipole kinematic expectation persists for every alpha in the grid; per-axis statistical sd ~3e-4 to 7e-4.

SNe and PV cannot test it: per-axis sd 4e-3 to 1.3e-2 (>= the count-implied boost). Cost of the count best fit in those channels: dchi2 ~4 (SNe) and ~6.5 (PV) for 3 dof, not significant. The earlier 'tension' wording is withdrawn: SN/PV are uninformative at this level, not in conflict.
Gaia does not constrain beta_MO at all (sd ~1e4): the glide response is absorbed by the 3 marginalised nuisance modes in the likelihood design matrix (H[0:3,0:3]); design question, unresolved.
H_loc remains best by BIC for all alpha; H_mix Delta_BIC 1.4-1.6 (Gaia block saturated); H_tilt equals the null (beta_RM not in any channel).

DATA PROVENANCE DEFECT: two of the four count blocks are hard-coded literals in the likelihood module with no source file (Quaia G<20.5: amplitude 0.0212 at l=255.4, b=37.1; RACS: amplitude 0.018 +- 0.004 at l=245, b=35). The sourced blocks alone (Quaia G<20, NVSS) imply beta 3.9e-3 to 5.1e-3 (alpha grid), the literal blocks 3.7e-3 to 5.3e-3. These literals must be replaced by sourced values (e.g. RACS from the validated estimator on RACS-low, which has not been run unblinded) before any physical reading.

claims.claim: Count-dipole amplitudes exceed the kinematic expectation for the CMB-dipole speed by 3.0-3.6x under the derived response over alpha 0.5-1.0.
claims.limit: two of four blocks are unsourced literals; derived inputs; response model first-order; no systematics

claims.claim: Physical boost, tilt or anisotropy detected.
